title: Greifswald Nuclear Plant Units 5–8
summary: Four VVER-440 reactors at the Lubmin/Greifswald site in East Germany were in various stages of construction when German reunification triggered immediate safety reviews in 1990. The first four units were shut down; the partially-built units 5–8 were cancelled outright and never commissioned. Decommissioning of the entire site, managed by EWN, became one of the largest nuclear cleanup operations in Europe.
